concerns.text: The three cited HuggingFace datasets are assumed to provide diffusion tractography streamlines and resting‑state BOLD time‑series. However, the first URL (7eu7d7/HCP-Diffusion-datas) appears to host raw diffusion images, not pre‑processed tractography. Without tractography the pipeline cannot construct the binary structural connectomes required by FR‑002, making the dataset inappropriate for the research question.

The performance goal of ≤ 300 seconds per subject for motif enumeration (SC‑002) on a GitHub Actions free runner (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM) is optimistic given the need to generate ≥ 1000 Maslov‑Sneppen null graphs and count all 3‑node and 4‑node motifs. This may exceed the allotted CPU time and cause CI timeouts, risking infeasibility of the analysis.
